questions.question: This role requires FACETS experience. What experience do you have with FACETS, and which modules, business processes, or data areas have you worked with?
Describe how you would elicit business needs from a Product Owner and translate them into clear, testable user stories with acceptance criteria.
In your Product Owner/Data Analyst role at Leidos, how did you gather, refine, document, and obtain signoff for functional and non-functional requirements during the data migration project?
Walk me through a complex reporting or data requirement you gathered from business stakeholders. How did you clarify the metric definitions, source data, business rules, and expected output?
You developed business rules supporting data quality and integrity at Incloudcounsel. Can you give an example of a rule you defined, how it was validated, and how you handled exceptions?
How have you used Azure DevOps to manage a backlog, document requirements, track work, or collaborate with developers and QA teams?
Describe your approach to prioritizing competing requests when business stakeholders want multiple reports, features, or process changes delivered at the same time.

At Leidos, you created more than 50 test cases and established QA and business acceptance testing criteria. How did you ensure requirements were traceable through development, testing, and deployment?

Tell me about the documentation repository you helped implement at Carefirst. How did you identify the underlying business problem, define requirements for the repository, and measure whether it improved outcomes?

This role includes mentoring junior BAs and growing domain knowledge across technical teams. What practices would you use to onboard a new BA and help a delivery team build shared understanding of a business domain?
